title.zh: 加拿大央行三年多来首次加息，未来可能再次加息
title.en: 加拿大央行三年多来首次加息，未来可能再次加息

current_state.zh: The Bank of Canada raised its benchmark rate 25bp to 2.50% — its first hike in over three years — and said further increases may be necessary, projecting inflation well above the 2% target until 2028 while citing trade disputes, Middle East conflict and AI-driven business investment as key factors.
